indivCategories.description: A = Hits + Walks - Caught Stealing + Hit by Pitch - GIDP, B = Total Bases + (0.26 x (Walks - Intentional Walks + Hit by Pitch)), C = 0.52 x (Sacrifice Hits + Sacrifice Flies + Stolen Bases), D = AB + BB + HBP + SH + SF; Runs Created = (A x B + C) / D

indivCategories.name: Runs Created 2
indivCategories.description: A = Hits + Walks - Caught Stealing + Hit by Pitch - GIDP, B = Total Bases + (0.26 x (Walks - Intentional Walks + Hit by Pitch)), C = 0.52 x (Sacrifice Hits + Sacrifice Flies + Stolen Bases - Caught Stealing), D = AB + BB + HBP + SH + SF; Runs Created 2 = (A x B + C) / D

indivCategories.name: Runs Produced
indivCategories.description: Runs Batted In + Runs Scored - Home Runs

indivCategories.name: Runs Scored 1+
indivCategories.description: Scorer has scored at Least 1 run.

indivCategories.name: Sacrifice Flies
indivCategories.description: A fly ball out to the outfield which allows a runner already on base to score.

indivCategories.name: Sacrifice Flies
indivCategories.description: A fly ball out to the outfield which allows a runner already on base to score.

indivCategories.name: Sacrifice Hits + Sacrifice Flies + Stolen Bases
indivCategories.description: Sacrifice Hits + Sacrifice Flies + Stolen Bases

indivCategories.name: Saves
indivCategories.description: When the pitcher enters a game where his team is leading, finishes the game without surrendering the lead, is not the winning pitcher, and either (a) the lead was 3 runs or less when the pitcher entered the game; (b) the potential tying run was on base, at bat, or on deck; or (c) the pitcher pitched three or more innings.

indivCategories.name: Short Starts
indivCategories.description: A value of '1' is set if the pitcher starts but only pitches less than 3 innings (used as a form of penalization). Typically, negative points are assigned for this category in a points league.

indivCategories.name: Short Starts (Weak)
indivCategories.description: A value of '1' is set if the pitcher starts but only pitches less than 3 innings (used as a form of penalization), and allows more than 4 runs. Typically, negative points are assigned for this category in a points league.

indivCategories.name: Shutouts
indivCategories.description: A complete game pitched with no runs allowed.

indivCategories.name: Slugging Percentage Against
indivCategories.description: Total Bases Allowed / At Bats Against

indivCategories.name: Starting Pitching Contribution
indivCategories.description: Starter Wins - Starter Losses + Quality Starts

indivCategories.name: Stolen Bases 2
indivCategories.description: Same as Stolen Bases. Not necessary unless you want to have to separate SB categories, in order to calculate them differently (e.g. one per game, and the other per season or per period (in H2H leagues).

indivCategories.name: Stolen Bases Against
indivCategories.description: Awarded to the Catcher and Pitcher, when a baserunner on the opposing team steals a base.

indivCategories.name: Strike Rate
indivCategories.description: Strikes pitched per number of pitches

indivCategories.name: Strikeouts and Grounded into Double Plays combo
indivCategories.description: Strikeouts + (2 x Grounded into Double Plays)

indivCategories.description: Strikeouts Pitched Per Batters Faced Percentage

indivCategories.name: Strong Starts
indivCategories.description: Pitcher has to pitch at least 4 innings, and either allow 0 runs or have WHIP <= 0.75 - IP >= 4.0 AND (ERA = 0 or WHIP <= 0.75)

indivCategories.name: Total + Stolen Bases
indivCategories.description: BB + 1B + (2 x 2B) + (3 x 3B) + HBP + (SB - CS) - GIDP

indivCategories.name: Total Bases
indivCategories.description: Singles + (2 x Doubles) + (3 x Triples) + (4 x Home Runs)

indivCategories.description: Total Bases + Walks + Hit By Pitches

indivCategories.name: Total Bases 4
indivCategories.description: (2 x Doubles) + (3 x Triples) + (4 x Home Runs)

indivCategories.name: Total Bases 5
indivCategories.description: BB + HBP + Singles + (2 x Doubles) + (3 x Triples) + (4 x Home Runs)

indivCategories.name: Total Bases Allowed
indivCategories.description: Singles Allowed + (2 x Doubles Allowed) + (3 x Triples Allowed) + (4 x Home Runs Allowed)

indivCategories.name: UFS RP
indivCategories.description: (Saves + Relief Wins - Blown Saves) x 9 - (Earned Runs x 2)

indivCategories.name: UFS SP
indivCategories.description: (Games Started x Starter Wins x 5) - (Starter Losses x 5) + (Innings Pitched x 3) - (Earned Runs x 3)
